researched_by: the council's own consultation pages and the statutory press notice, plus press coverage
policy_summary:
The Cornwall Council (Off Street Parking Places) Order 2026, made under section 35(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984, revoking and replacing the 2024 Order. Consultation closed 4 February 2026; revised proposals went to Cabinet on 18 March 2026.

Overnight sleeping is prohibited in Cornwall Council car parks generally, with a ban on remaining in most affected car parks between 23:00 and 08:00. Against that, a trial at Bude was judged successful and designated sites were proposed where fully self-contained motorhomes may stay 18:00 to 09:00.

The proposal shrank during consultation. Ten designated car parks were floated in January; the revised order names four - Link Road Padstow, Watergate Bay, Trenwith in St Ives and Wheal Leisure in Perranporth. It also ADDS a new motorhome prohibition at Commercial Road, Hayle.

Self-contained here means an onboard toilet and sealed containers for waste water and sewage. A converted van with a portable loo does not qualify, and is also caught by the ban everywhere else - so Cornwall offers self-builds nothing.
notes:
Two things to carry forward.

The definition catches more than people expect: the draft order defines a motorhome or campervan as any vehicle adapted for sleeping, even if also used for other purposes. And the restriction bites on PRESENCE, not sleeping - a resident was fined GBP70 for leaving his motorhome overnight in a car park he had paid for, without sleeping in it. He argued the penalty should be void on that basis. It was not.

Second, the shrinking pattern. Ten sites became four, exactly as Pembrokeshire went from four to one. Two of the three biggest van destinations in England and Wales reduced their provision during consultation. Worth tracking as a trend rather than a coincidence.
open_questions: What did Cabinet decide on 18 March 2026? The revised order is the live question and this record predates confirmation.
Price for the designated sites - not published in the consultation material seen.
Is the Bude trial site continuing, and on what terms?
Which car parks exactly are covered by the 23:00-08:00 ban? Reporting names around fifteen; the order will list them all.
